scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by an exact finite-dimensional dissipation identity; 9 exact rational and 120 floating-point checks are supplementary, not infinite certificates. The historical priority of implicit formulations remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Finite, nearest-neighbor, noninteracting, two symmetric boundary reservoirs and strictly positive uniform dephasing; comparison at fixed rates; no claim for zero dephasing or noise-rate optimization. Earlier exact response equations and clean current are credited.
title: A strict clean-chain current ceiling from coherence dissipation in tilted quantum transport
